      gets whether the review view of the capture shows the user the captured image. If false, then just a review of the evaluated qualities metrics are shown instead of the captured image. Defaults to true.

      builder

    • setSingleFingerCaptureExplicitType

      ICaptureRequestBuilder setSingleFingerCaptureExplicitType(FingerType singleFingerCaptureExplicitType)
      sets the explicitly set finger type for single finger captures. Only used with CaptureRequestType.SingleFingerCapture. If omitted, the user will determine which finger is captured. FingerType.UNKNOWN by default.
      Parameters:
      singleFingerCaptureExplicitType - the explicit finger that will be captured. FingerType.UNKNOWN by default.
      Returns:
      builder

    • setMissingFingerMapping

      ICaptureRequestBuilder setMissingFingerMapping(Map<FingerType,FpCondition> missingFingerMapping)
      sets a mapping for pre-known missing fingers being captured for this request. This is optional. Any finger types not present in the map for fingers present in the captureType will be initialized to 'normal'. Using this option does not disable the ability to change the missing fingers during the capture. Setting individual fingers to FpCondition.Exclude will make those fingers not show nor be collected during capture (this allows capture requests for different non-four-finger permutations like 2 finger slaps by setting the ring and little fingers to FpCondition.Exclude)
      Parameters:
      missingFingerMapping - a mapping for pre-known missing fingers being captured for this request
      Returns:
      builder
